title: Immunome Announces Detailed Phase 3 RINGSIDE Data for Varegacestat in Adults with Progressing Desmoid Tumors at the 2026 ASCO Annual Meeting
summary: BOTHELL, Wash., May 30, 2026--Immunome, Inc. (Nasdaq: IMNM), a biotechnology company committed to developing first-in-class and best-in-class targeted cancer therapies, today announced detailed efficacy and safety results from RINGSIDE, the global, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 3 trial of varegacestat in patients with progressing desmoid tumors. The data are being presented today in an oral abstract session at the 2026 American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) Annual Meet
